name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability this tool should have
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem are you trying to solve?**
Describe the situation, not the solution. "When my quota runs out I have to ...",
"I cannot tell whether Pi is using the account I just signed in to ...".

**What do you do today?**
The workaround, if any, and where you found it.

**What would the ideal outcome look like?**
One or two sentences. A command you wish existed is a perfectly good answer.

**Environment**
- `pi-dsh-bridge doctor --json` output (it never contains a credential)
- `pi --version`, `dsh --version`, node version, OS
